rules_text:
Rules summary Objective Meet one of the 6 winning conditions to win the game. (See Table in upper right) To win • Cards in your hand must match the winning conditions exactly (cannot have extra cards) • You do not win the round that you achieve the condition. You declare victory the following round. Game Play On your turn, either • Draw a card from deck or from your own or the top card from another player's discard pile • Discard a card Special note about "A" • If you discard an A, everyone pass a card to the player on their left (total number of cards in your hand does not change). • You cannot draw an A from the discard pile Game End All players are dealt 5 cards to restart a new round when 1 player wins a round. The player who first wins 2 rounds wins the game.

Makes it very challenging to get the precise thing, especially since half the time all you can do is draw a card blind or discard (but sometimes you're allowed to draw from other players discards and sometimes you're forced to pass cards? so strange, and just leads to even more chaos).
